messages:
maya: Quick sync: Sales wants FalconLite-v3 pinned for a pilot. Benchmarks look noisy; propose we gate pinning.

devon: Gate criteria? latency tails or quality variance?

liza: Primarily quality variance on long-form summarization. Current runs show ~6% seed-to-seed variance.

maya: We also see occasional KV cold-start latency spikes ~2x.

alex: Could we publish as preview in catalog but disable pinning? Add a clear pin policy note.

sam: Customer X needs pin for compliance. They said preview ok if we give a 7-day status update and a tentative timeline for pin.

devon: If we allow pinning we must provide a rollback path to v2; that changes outputs and may surprise customers. Rollback tooling ETA ~6 business days.

liza: I can re-run evals with N=40 seeds in 48-72h if a GPU slot is freed. That should reduce sampling noise.

maya: Options: (A) Hold pin, offer dedicated preview canary; (B) Allow pin with pin-exception + TTL; (C) Catalog preview only, no pin.

alex: Ops prefers C; lower risk. Sales leans B.

liza: I started N=40 run now 8. Will post results in this thread.

opsbot: bench-bot: job queued (id 2026-05-24-1010) for N=40 seed run.

maya: Decision rule: if N=40 shows <3% variance and median >= baseline, allow preview canary on dedicated infra and revisit pin. Otherwise block pin and publish preview-only.

liza: Results: median quality 75.0 (baseline v2 76.1), variance 5.7%. Underperforms baseline and variance still >3%.

maya: Per gate, we will block pinning. Offer dedicated preview canary (no pin) and give customer a 7-day status update.

sam: Customer accepts preview-only and wants a status check next week.

alex: I'll publish the preview entry with explicit "no pin" language and known issues.

devon: I'll deprioritize immediate rollback automation but keep it on the backlog.

maya: Action items: liza -> follow-up stability run after infra tweaks; alex -> catalog blurb + pin-exception template; devon -> rollback plan doc. Reconvene after customer update. :thumbsup:
